title: Democrats have a midterm edge, poll shows. And, Israelis vote in high-stakes election
description: Democrats are still holding a slight edge with Election Day a week away, according to a new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll. And, Israelis are casting their votes in an election that could change leadership.

title: Can Black voting power and Trump fatigue break Mississippi's red wall?
description: Mississippi has the largest proportional Black population in the country. It's one reason the U.S. Senate race has seen millions in last-minute spending and high-profile campaign visits.

title: Polymarket has investigated 'dozens' of election-related cases
description: The prediction market has hired a former FBI official to make sure political insiders don't use the platform for profit from confidential election information.

title: Democrats still poised to make gains, but poll shows warning signs for just how many
description: Democrats hold significant advantages going into Election Day, according to a new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll. But lagging enthusiasm among key groups is just one indicator that gains may not come easy.

title: Data centers are a hot-button issue for Ohioans as midterms near
description: In Ohio, many people are displeased with the state's rapid buildout of data centers. It's a hot-button issue in the midterms, as political candidates from both parties try to ease voter concerns.

title: Trump campaigns in Mississippi, highlighting Republicans' challenges
description: President Trump campaigned Monday in Mississippi, as he continued a closing midterm rally blitz that has highlighted Republicans' challenges ahead of an election that could drastically shift power in Washington.

title: Trump administration attempting to prosecute former FBI Director James Comey again
description: The Trump administration is attempting to prosecute James Comey for what it calls a decade-old leak of classified information. Comey's lawyers immediately dismissed the effort as invalid and outside the time limit.

title: Judge says DOJ illegally fired the daughter of former FBI director Comey
description: Maurene Comey served as a federal prosecutor in Manhattan for around a decade. A judicial ruling finding her dismissal unlawful adds to concerns of politically motivated firings at the DOJ.

title: Redistricting isn't playing out how the GOP hoped. And, Brazil's Lula wins 4th term
description: Republicans are spending millions on the midterms, and they still may not win districts drawn to favor them. And, Brazil's Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won a fourth term in a stunning political comeback.

title: Political consultant on the impact of Republicans' gerrymandering efforts
description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with political consultant Mike Madrid about how Republicans' gerrymandering efforts have backfired.
